ENTIRE native64x64 original soft crooked muted pale blue-gray electric painttrace on black. Follow exactly the ORIGINAL thin asymmetric curving network running from lowerleft through the central subdued junction toward upperright, with existing longer down-right curve and weaker small upper/central tails. Preserve EVERY original faint pixel-domain path/gap/relative strength without straightening, thickening, coarsening, sharpening or adding branch geometry. Literal one connected RGB-positive native bitmapdomain is a diagnostic, NOT one physicallycounted bolt/particle and not permission to regularize it. Original peak at16,34 RGB234/237/239 is existing pale pigment, not a new spark/star/white bead. Retain native soft painted blur/irregular strengths and fullUV placement, not photoreal electricity or extra filaments.

Preserve original maximum-pigment nativephase/relative strength without inventing a physicalcore/glint; this diagnostic is not an instruction to draw a newshape. The original whole reference is the authority for every plateau pixel; numericnativebbox is only a diagnostic, NEVER crop or fit.

No new objects, rays, rings, sparkles, grain, coarse cells, cloudmottle, whitecore, photo rendering, surfaces, hardware, newglints, outlines, text or symbols. Keep original darkness, native sourceblur and weak pigment.
